title: "Zainab Ujar Gayi Zainab Ujar Gayi Zainab Ujar Gayi Lyrics Punjabi 2026"
language: "Panjabi"

kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Akbar"

aliases: []

1
Zainab Ujar Gayi Zainab Ujar Gayi Zainab Ujar Gayi.
Chaan Loko Sir Te Zainab De Babay Di Na Rayi.
Ja Namazaan Wain Paye, Roiyaan Masjid Di Diwaraan.
Kabay Nu Zakhmi Tak Tak Ke Takbeer Ro Payi.

2
Sain Aakhay Veer Ghazi, Amari Di Turbat Te Le Ja.
Hun Sadhay Rehn De Qabil Aye Basti Nahi Rayi.
Jang Karni Nayi Aithay, Babay Ne Jandiyaan Dasiya.
Ban Gayi Karbal Wich Kofay De Abbas De Layi.

3
Zakhmi Baba Aykho Sochay, Deway Gi Khutbay Kiwein.
Apne Babay De Samne V Jehri Boldi Nayi.
Aayi Akbar Aisi Ghurbat, Lokaan Nazraan Phair Laiyaan.
Babay Di Shahi Khatam Hoi Aoulad Rul Gayi.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/zainab-ujar-gayi-zainab-ujar-gayi-zainab-ujar-gayi-lyrics-punjabi-2026-tajpoints-bb6a92c552be312e14e9.md')
s = p.read_text()
_, meta, body = s.split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for part, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = part.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 3
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) == 5 and lines[0].strip() == number
assert '\\u200c' not in s
print('Verified three matching four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Shahmukhi Punjabi title and all 12 verses. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics` and verified that both versions have three four-verse stanzas in the same order. Updated the script metadata to `pa-Arab` and `rtl` and removed the missing-source tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman `Aykho` as `ایہو`.
